row.body: The keyring is clipped to a blank page in the studio desk. The only pencilled line says “doors locked”; the box for who checked them is empty.
row.title: The studio key clipped to a blank rundown

sidecar.gloss: A locked studio and an unsigned check remain on the same page.
sidecar.rival_reading: A broadcast worker could secure the studio before any emergency and leave the checklist unfinished; the blank box does not prove a failed containment order.
